# Gasses 3 Utility gasses with niche but well defined uses.
## Pluoxium
A highly potent super-oxidizer. Can be used to massively increase the lifespan of oxygen based internals or to ignite flammable gasses below their normal ignition point. As well, it is non-toxic to all species.
Pluoxium can be produced by combining 2 carbon dioxide with 1 oxygen under 273 K and either exposing the mix to radiation or introducing tritium which will be converted to hydrogen.
## Ulnitranium
A highly potent super-nitrater. Can be used to massively increase the lifespan of nitrogen based internals.
Ulnitranium can be produced by combining 2 nitrous oxide with 1 nitrogen under 273 K and either exposing the mix to radiation or introducing tritium which will be converted to hydrogen.
## ZXA
A universal sleeping agent which works on all organic lifeforms. Has minor genetic regeneration properties.
ZXA can be produced combining 1 BZ, 1 nitrous oxide, with a water vapor catalyst that is slowly consumed. Similar to its precursor BZ, it forms faster at lower pressures and can cause decomposition of the nitrous oxide when there is too much BZ.
## Halon
An incredibly thin gas that has unique fire suppressing properties.
When exposed to fire halon will immediately bind with the oxygen, turning both into carbon dioxide while massively cooling the area.
Halon can be made by electrolyzing BZ.
